name: Eszter Kovács
bio:
Eszter's fascination with motorsport began early, watching Formula 1 races with her father, a former mechanic. She pursued a vocational degree in mechanical engineering in Budapest, specializing in fabrication and welding. After graduating, she gained experience at a local tuning shop, where she honed her skills in custom exhaust systems and chassis modifications. Eager to work at the highest level, she sought an opportunity abroad and was thrilled to join Brad Jones Racing as a fabricator.

Eszter is known for her meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality. She believes that even the smallest fabrication errors can have significant consequences on the track, so she insists on precision and accuracy in every task. Her calm demeanor allows her to perform well under pressure, making her a valuable asset during demanding race weekends. 

What sets Eszter apart is her innovative approach to problem-solving. While deeply respectful of established methods, she's always looking for ways to improve processes and enhance the performance of the race cars. She isn't afraid to challenge the status quo and suggest new solutions, making her a rising star within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Eszter is of average height with a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an exact point before starting a task.
Listens to classical music through noise-canceling headphones while working.
Insists on thoroughly cleaning her workspace at the end of each day.
